correctness.rationale: A size-10 code is explicitly verified. For an eleven-word code, elementary distance arguments force minimum distance 2, 3, or 4; normalization of a closest pair leaves finitely many complete symmetry orbits for a third word, and the standalone exact verifier exhausts every completion while enforcing every separating triple. All orbit maxima are at most 10.

originality.rationale: Korze-Vesel (2023) reported only a lower bound 10 at Q_8 and exactness through Q_7. An August 2026 survey explicitly states that the only exact hypercube values known are through Q_7 and records the equivalence to (2,1)-separating systems. Searches across frameproof-code and separating-system terminology found no exact length-eight result. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with a stated residual access risk for Sun-Wang (2025).

value.rationale: The theorem closes the first unresolved hypercube dimension after the known exact range and simultaneously determines the exact maximum for binary length-eight (2,1)-separating systems and binary 2-frameproof codes.
